answer: Anchor each identity to a decaying bond: joining locks 10 POA, and the bond loses 1 POA per epoch unless the agent works, so idle identities drop out. A vine of fakes cannot share one deposit, since each identity needs its own bond: 1000 fakes lock 10000 POA and lose 1000 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays only 10 POA and recovers it by working. At the nadir, the asymmetry holds: honest entry stays cheap, attackers pay linearly per fake.
